Title: M-series virtual machines (VMs) are now available in Australia Central region.

Body.Content:
Azure M-series VMs are now available in the Australia Central region. M-series VMs offer configurations with memory from 192 GB to 3.8 TiB (4 TB) RAM and are certified for SAP HANA. For more information on M-series availability by region and for upcoming region launches,  visit the Azure regions page.

Learn more about running SAP workloads on Azure
